title: The subset-stage bound requires an infinite cardinal.
details: In the2026-01-31 version, Lemma21.3 printed/PDF p.90 says that under V=L, for every cardinal kappa and x⊆kappa there is lambda<kappa-plus with x∈L_lambda. Definition9.4 includes finite cardinals and Definition9.7 defines their successor in the usual way. Take kappa=0 and x=empty: then kappa-plus=1, so the only lambda<1 is0, but L_0 is empty and has no member x. Repair: require kappa infinite, as needed for the stated size-kappa elementary hull and the subsequent infinite-level cardinal count. This is exactly the scope used to prove GCH. The same proof also writes pi(alpha)=alpha for alpha≤kappa although only kappa⊆N was required; either restrict that statement to alpha<kappa, which suffices to fix x, or include kappa itself among the hull parameters. The latter does not change an infinite hull size.
